root.name: Pirc Defense: Bayonet Attack
root.moves: 1. e4 d6 2. d4 Nf6 3. Nc3 g6 4. Be2 Bg7 5. h4

overview: White plays 5.h4 with Be2 on, gaining kingside space and h5 ideas, without committing to the Austrian or 150 set-ups. Black has the usual Pirc set-up and strikes with ...c5 or ...Nc6 and ...e5 in the centre. Play is sharp, with pawn storms on the kingside while Black counters in the centre.

white_ideas.idea: Advance h4-h5 to open lines on the kingside

typical_structures.structure: Pirc with e4/d4 centre against fianchetto

character.notes: h4 against the Pirc leads to a pawn storm and counter-attack.

soundness.notes: Sound at club level; the parent line is respectable.

level.notes: Needs prepared replies and sensible plans.
